checkedAlternates.risk: The esophagus runs right behind the trachea in the neck and thorax.
checkedAlternates.resolution: The esophagus conducts food to the stomach as part of the digestive tract (group-4), not air to the lungs (group-3).

checkedAlternates.risk: The liver secretes bile and regulates blood glucose.
checkedAlternates.resolution: The liver is an accessory digestive organ producing bile (group-4), not a ductless endocrine gland (group-2).
